title: Narrare Configuration Adoption Matrix
description: Validates configuration-adoption-matrix.yaml structure per ADR-051. Every material configuration value must have exactly one lifecycle classification and, where applicable, a source -> resolver -> runtime-consumer -> evidence chain.

expected_setting_ids.description: Every CR-08 setting_id that MUST appear in entries. The checker fails if any is missing or if an entry references an id not listed here.

lifecycle.description: ADR-051 lifecycle state: the adoption state of the value.

classification.description: ADR-051 matrix-row classification: the kind/layer of the setting. user/project require runtime_consumer + enforcement_evidence.

setting_id.description: Stable name used by docs, tests, and evidence.

resolver_service.description: Single resolver that normalizes the value.

runtime_consumer.description: Function/class that applies the value at the runtime boundary. Required when classification is user or project.

effect_semantics.description: What observable runtime behavior changes when the value changes.

fallback_policy.description: Fail-fast, warning, cap, offline/unknown label, or last-resort default.

enforcement_evidence.description: Unit/integration/contract/checker evidence that blocks regressions. Required (non-empty) when lifecycle is adopted or classification is user/project.

cross_layer_evidence.description: Proof that frontend/backend/core/platform vocabulary agrees when applicable.

review_trigger.description: Condition under which this classification must be re-evaluated.
